Rep.  BY THE PP, ASSAM Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. R ALI Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM  BEFORE  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE MITALI THAKURIA  ORDER 20.01.2023 Heard Mr. H. A. Ahmed, learned counsel for the applicants.

Also heard Mr. K. K.
Parasar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State respondent.
This is an application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for grant of pre-arrest bail to the accused/applicants, who are apprehending arrest in connection with Barpeta Police Station Case No.1178/2022, registered under Sections 468/420/506/294/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
Page No.# 3/4 Mr. H. A. Ahmed, learned counsel for the applicants submits that this case is purely civil in nature.
He submits that the informant has filed this FIR against the applicants only to harass them as there is a land dispute is going on between the parties.
It is also submitted that one Title Suite being No.311/2011, which is still pending before the learned Munsiff No.2, Barpeta in evidence stage for the same plot of land.
Further the applicants pray for interim protections and they are also ready to co-operate with the investigation of this case, if they are granted with the privilege of pre-arrest bail.
In this context, Mr. K. K. Parasar, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, submits that the schedule of the land mentioned in the FIR and the pending Title Suit No.311/2022, is of the same land.
The learned Additional Public Prosecutor has raised no objections if the applicants are granted the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail.
Page No.# 1/4 vs The State Of Assam on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45428954/

2 Considering the submissions of learned counsels of sides and also considering the nature and gravity of the case, I find it a fit case to grant the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail to the accused/applicants, till receipt of the case.

Accordingly, it is provided that in the event of arrest of the accused/applicants, namely, 1. Sri Nabab Ali, 2. Sri Altab Ali, 3. Sri Sikim Ali, 4. Ms. Suratjan Nessa, 5. Sri Meser Ali, 6. Sri Baser Ali, and 7.
Call for the Case Diary.
List the matter again on 27.02.2023.

Sri Sattar Ali, in connection with Barpeta Police Station Case No.1178/2022, registered under Sections 468/420/506/294/34 of the Indian Penal Code, they shall be enlarged Page No.# 4/4 on interim pre-arrest bail on their executing a bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) each with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, subject to the following conditions:
(i) that the applicants shall make themselves available for interrogation by the Investigating Officer within 7 days from today;
(ii) that the applicants shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer; and (iii) that the applicants shall not leave the jurisdiction of the concerned jurisdictional Magistrate, without prior permission.
List the matter again on 27.02.2023.
